register: Jalsa Restaurant — fact register (provenance authority for this workspace)
rules: A fact is VERIFIED only with customer verification or approval evidence. None exists, so no fact is VERIFIED.
Customer material is evidence that the material SAYS something, not proof that it is true, current or approved for publication.
MEASURED means the framework measured a customer file (dimensions, colours, metadata). A measurement is not a brand decision.
FRAMEWORK_INFERENCE is operator/AI judgment. It is never presented as the customer's statement.
`inventoryStatuses` must equal the engine seam record's availableAssets/availableContent (tests/scenarios/jalsa-real-customer.test.ts).

statusBasis.logo: a file was supplied; whether it is the restaurant's official, current logo, and its origin, are unconfirmed (F-004)
statusBasis.brandColors: colours are visible in the logo (F-005); no brand colour value was stated
statusBasis.portfolioImages / customerLogos / caseSt: FRAMEWORK_INFERENCE: a restaurant has no client portfolio, client logos or case studies; marked not_applicable so the framework does not ask the customer for them
statusBasis.pricing: 52 prices are present in a document headed "For design illustrations only" (F-006, F-008)
statusBasis.datasets: the menu table is structured data, present but unverified (F-007)
statusBasis.everything unavailable: not present in either supplied file
